items.item: A stepper names each step and lets the user go back to earlier steps
items.evidence: renderStepper() names Upload / Map columns / Review / Import, but the <li> items are plain, not buttons or links. Going back is only through 'Choose another file' and 'Back to mapping' buttons, one step at a time; the stepper cannot jump to an earlier step.

items.item: Column mapping auto-matches headers and marks required target fields
items.evidence: autoMap() matches normalised headers against FIELDS[].alias; the page says 'We matched N of 8 fields by header name'. Required fields get a red ' *' plus sr-only '(required)'. Unmapped required fields show an alert and disable 'Validate and preview'.

items.item: The preview table shows per-row errors and an error count, and offers to download the failing rows
items.evidence: The Review step has inline per-cell errors (input.cell.bad with a message under it), a 'Rows with errors' count, an Errors filter tab and an error summary. The download ('Download skipped rows with reasons (CSV)', #dl) only appears on the final Import-complete screen, not in the preview.

items.item: The import shows progress, can continue in the background, and ends with a summary of created, updated and failed rows
items.evidence: startImport() drives a progressbar (#bar, '3 of 17 products'). The text says 'Keep this tab open until the import finishes', and there is no run-in-background or leave-and-notify option. The summary shows Created / Updated / Skipped; failed rows appear only as 'Skipped'.

items.item: The flow runs on a page or a full-width panel, not inside a small modal
items.evidence: Full page with <main class="max-w-6xl"> and <section id="panel">; no dialog or modal element.

items.item: A template file is offered for download before upload
items.evidence: The Upload step has a 'Download template' button (#tpl) that creates product-import-template.csv with the header row and one sample row.

notes: The audit score is 100 with no violations. The page is clean and restrained, with no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI icon tiles or decorative charts. The uppercase tracking-wide appears only on table header cells (mapping and review tables). The review and import stat boxes are bordered cards inside the bordered panel. Indigo is the accent, but there is no navy sidebar. The main gaps are the non-interactive stepper, the failing-rows download offered only after import, no background import, and the 'Skipped' wording instead of 'failed'. The 'S' logo tile is a brand mark, not an avatar, so it is not counted.
